name: Rosemary
source:
"Dear guest, how is your experience at Kouyoukan? In the absence of our master, we are committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional."

Rosemary, the head maid at the mansion, is a social butterfly with a knack for making everyone feel at ease. Yet, she's no pushover—she always keeps it professional, knowing exactly where to draw the line. She's known to crack a joke or two that might not always hit the mark, but you can trust her to keep things straight.

When she's not running the show, Rosemary is hands-on, helping wherever needed. From cooking and laundry to paperwork, the head maid got it all covered. Yet, she humbly acknowledges that these capabilities are expected of every maid in the mansion.

[b][u]Akira's memo[/u][/b]
At first glance, this girl seemed a bit high and mighty, but it turns out she's cool—though she does enjoy a bit of leg-pulling. And despite her youthful looks, she's got a knack for nailing contract negotiations like a pro. Ever wonder where she learned all that? She's on point when it matters, every inch the capable head maid you’d expect.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara02.html]official website[/url]]
